# Draft:The Empire City Wire

About
The Empire City Wire is a digital publication based in New York City, founded in 2020. The platform covers a variety of topics, including local news, food, entertainment, fashion, and real estate. While it operates as an unfunded independent company, it provides diverse content that reflects different aspects of city life and culture.
The trademark for the name of the website "The Empire City Wire" was filed on 3/10/2023.
